summary_bullets: The top three serotypes of 46 isolated Salmonella strains were Salmonella I 4,[5],12:i:- (34.78%), Typhimurium (23.91%), and Enteritidis (17.39%).

papers.title: Identification of small ubiquitin-related modifier (SUMO)-related genes-based biomarkers in Alzheimer's disease based on bioinformatics analysis.
summary_bullets: The study identified 107 candidate genes that may serve as diagnostic biomarkers for Alzheimer's disease (AD) based on small ubiquitin-like modification (SUMO)-related genes.

papers.title: A recurrent sequencing artifact on Illumina sequencers with two-color fluorescent dye chemistry and its impact on somatic variant detection.
summary_bullets: We observed a higher frequency of T-to-G and A-to-C substitutions on the NovaSeq 6000 compared to HiSeq X10.

The excess T > G variants disproportionately occur at NT[TG] trinucleotides and can be bioinformatically reduced to minimize its impact on somatic mutation callsets.
